name: Dutch Reformed Church, Wellington
scope: The standing NG Moederkerk in Wellington, including its brick clock tower and spire, transverse wings, raised nave roof, rear vestry and front ring-wall entry.
era: Current standing exterior with the 1895 tower and 1928 raised roof

originalReview.notes: Shows the Main Road elevation with a tall pale needle spire, sculpted clock shoulders, arcaded lantern, rounded side openings, tall arched sash, red tile and the front gate.

review.method: Author’s native PD-self upload log and exact cleared Qualla bytes.
review.notes: The file was first uploaded to Afrikaans Wikipedia by Morne on April 13, 2007. The native log includes Morne’s May 11 release declaring PD-self and that it was specifically taken for the Wellington article. The later Commons copy supplies the credited source and exact published file. The initial Commons placeholder was assigned by the transfer account and the directly signed original release predates it.
